name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance (run through MUDRA/Department of Financial Services)
description: A flagship scheme offering collateral-free loans to non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises, helping small business owners and entrepreneurs access formal credit to start or grow their business without pledging assets as security.
benefits: Collateral-free loans across four categories: Shishu (up to Rs. 50,000), Kishore (Rs. 50,001-5 lakh), Tarun (Rs. 5-10 lakh), and Tarun Plus (Rs. 10-20 lakh, for repeat borrowers with a clean repayment record on an earlier Tarun loan). A MUDRA Card (RuPay debit card) is issued for flexible withdrawal of working capital.
eligibility: Indian citizen aged 18 to 65 years, running or planning to start a non-farm, income-generating micro or small enterprise
Total credit requirement must be up to Rs. 20 lakh
Applicant must not be a loan defaulter with any bank or financial institution and should have a satisfactory credit history
Relevant skills, experience, or knowledge related to the proposed business activity may be required
documents_required: Address proof (utility bill, Aadhaar, passport, or voter ID)
Business proof/plan (existing business proof or proposed activity details)
how_to_apply: Apply online via the Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or the JanSamarth portal, or visit any public/private sector bank/NBFC offering Mudra loans. Select the appropriate category (Shishu/Kishore/Tarun/Tarun Plus), fill the PMMY application form, submit documents, and await approval and disbursement.
